meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners, ads and app prompts on Indeed
meta.notes: **Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://www.indeed.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. `#onetrust-consent-sdk` was an empty host; no visible cookie banner, Google ad slot or app banner matched. The generic selectors are therefore unverified for visible Indeed content. `recipes/fixtures/indeed/` contains synthetic contract fixtures, not site captures.
